      13 A shell in three to build and test,
      14 A fourth for htop and the rest. 
      15 I detach and walk away,      
      16 The work persists another day.                                                                
      17 Reattach from any land,             
      18 The layout waits just as I planned.                            
      19 With prefix and a percent sign,
      20 I cleave the screen along a line.                                                                    
      21 With prefix and a double quote,
      22 I stack the panes like lines I wrote.
      23 The copy mode, a scrolling sea,         
      24 Where vi keys set my buffers free.
      25 I yank a line, I paste it through,
      26 From pane to pane the text flies true.                                   
      27 Synchronize and type just once,                                                                      
      28 Across ten hosts, a single stunt.                                                                    
      29 The config file, my dotfile pride,
      30 With bindings stored and themes applied.
      31 Plugins load from TPM,                                
      32 Resurrect saves every gem.     
      33 The sessions named for every task,
      34 Whatever project I might ask.       
      35 When laptops sleep and networks fail,                                                                
      36 My tmux keeps the steady trail.                                                                      
      37 So here's to you, multiplexer dear,
      38 Who keeps my terminals so clear.                                                                     
      39 Long live the panes, the windows wide,
      40 With tmux always by my side.
